### Outliers and Quality-Control Samples Removed

Finally, we remove both outliers and any quality-control samples.

```{r}
#| label: not-out-qc
max_group = find_maximum_pc(pca_data$not_outlier$pca$anova)
not_outlier_qc_variances = create_variance_values(
  pca_data$not_outlier_qc$pca$variance,
  ind = max_ind,
  group = max_group
)
```

